correctness.rationale: From contact x=h n+h'τ, separated antipodal pair gives w=p n+p'τ and envelope S=w−D n where D=p+p''=-8a cos3θ−24b cos5θ; differentiation gives w'=Dτ and S'=−D'n. Independent exact multiple-angle expansion reproduced QW=4y−3+3t(16y²−20y+5) and QS=4y−1+5t(16y²−12y+1) with y=cos²θ. Their discriminants 16(45t²+6t+1) and 16(125t²−10t+1) are everywhere positive; endpoints give only walls −1/3,−3/25,1/5. Since every interior y root supplies two angles mod π and factors cosθ/sinθ contribute one each, exact root tracing proves all four generic counts and a=0,b=0 boundaries. Taylor expansion at each wall determines orders 2,3 as claimed. Support-area Fourier orthogonality gives A=πR²−4πa²−12πb², AW*=−2πa²−6πb² and AS*=−18πa²−150πb². Explicit ±b curves satisfy R>8|a|+24|b| and equal stated invariants while their W cusp counts differ; independent rational/symbolic derivative, root and area checks corroborated. Counts refer to parameter occurrences, not distinct spatial images.
residual_risks: Proof concerns aligned cosine phase, exact convexity inequality and cusp parameters modulo π; not all constant-width ovals or every spatial self-intersection. Finite samples do not prove continuum classification; positive discriminants/endpoints do.
